Reproduce HEATDEATH v2.3.0
==========================

1. Obtain the annotated tag v2.3.0 and independently pin its commit.
2. Use Node v26.7.0 independently on darwin/arm64 and linux/x64.
3. Confirm npm 11.19.0, then run `npm ci --ignore-scripts`; verify the lockfile
   and registry attestations independently.
4. Run `npm run build:release` from a clean tagged worktree on each platform.
   The common bundle, source archive, SBOM and recipe must match byte-for-byte.
   The common SBOM excludes only host-selected optional native helpers; their
   logical package remains and the full lockfile hash is recorded in provenance.
5. Combine `heatdeath-darwin-arm64`, `heatdeath-linux-x64` and their two
   SOURCE-PROVENANCE files with one copy of the matching common artifacts,
   then run `node build/finalize-release.mjs dist`.
6. Check the SPDX SBOM and verify with
   `npm run verify-release -- --trusted-keys=/independent/key/dir`.

The JavaScript bundle is the primary auditable artifact. Each SEA convenience
binary embeds the exact Node runtime and is reproducible only on its named
platform. Node's Permission Model is a trusted-code capability guard, not a
sandbox for malicious code.
